authority: The new declared Studio import action changes the canonical UI action inventory, and the governed testing section requires the derived operational proof matrix to bind that current inventory.
expected_effect: Regenerate only registry/operational_control_proof_matrix.json from current admitted source inventories and control records.
rollback: Restore the prior generated matrix if the current-source equality test does not pass; no authoritative source inventory is changed.

evidence.claim: The governed section failed solely because the proof matrix retained the previous 199-action inventory hash while current source contains 200 declared actions.
